question: The Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine 2020 was awarded jointly to Harvey J Alter, Michael Houghton and Charles M rice for:

options.text: Discovery of molecular mechanisms controlling the circadian rhythm
Determining how cells sense and adapt to oxygen availability
Cancer therapy by inhibition of negative immune regulation

solution:
The correct answer is __**Discovery of Hepatitis C virus**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The 2020 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine is awarded to Harvey J. Alter, Michael Houghton, and Charles M. Rice. 

 
 
• They were awarded for the discovery of the Hepatitis C virus.​
 
• Hepatitis C is part of a group of hepatitis viruses that attack the Liver.
 
• It is transmitted through infected blood contacts, like a blood transfusion or infected syringe use, etc.
 
 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/254e3dce284cee06f2bdc5b1d0fc9038698069627cd2abf166f9fa79456899b5.png] 

 
• Hepatitis B vs Hepatitis C:

 
 
• The Hepatitis B virus is approximately 5-10 times more infectious than Hepatitis C and far more stable.
 
• The Hepatitis B virus has the ability to survive in extreme temperatures, whereas the Hepatitis C virus has been known to survive outside of the body for a short period of time on room-temperature surfaces.
 
• No vaccine is available for the Hepatitis-C virus, but it is available for the Hepatitis-B virus.
 
• A Nobel Prize in Medicine was given to **Baruch Blumberg in 1976 for the discovery of the Hepatitis-B virus**.
